checking.headline: Checking…
checking.said: Asking the API how the arena is doing.

down.headline: The API is {word}.
down.said: This site cannot read anything right now. What you can see elsewhere on it was loaded earlier and may be stale.

arena.say: We cannot tell. The arena reports through the API, and the API is not reporting.

api.say: The last read did not complete. This is ours to fix.

answering.saySlow: Reads are answering, but slowly — this one took {ms}.
answering.say: Every read this site makes is answering.

stopped.headline: The arena has {word}.
stopped.said: Nothing has finished for {ago}, and {queue} matches are waiting. The API is answering, so the standings you can see are correct — they are simply not moving.

arena.say: Matches are queued and none is finishing. Nothing is lost; the queue drains when it comes back.

behind.headline: The arena is {word}.
behind.saidCounting: Matches are being played, but the ratings are being counted more slowly than they arrive, so a new result may take a few minutes to reach the ladder.
behind.said: Matches are still being played, but slower than they are being queued, so a new result may take a few minutes to show up.

arena.sayCounting: {n} finished matches are waiting to be counted. Nothing is lost — results arrive late, not never.
arena.say: The queue is draining slower than it fills. Nothing is lost — results arrive late, not never.

running.headline: Everything is {word}.
running.said: The arena is playing matches and the API is answering. {n} matches finished in the last hour.

arena.say: Matches are being scheduled, played and rated normally.

api.title: The API
api.measured: Measured in your browser, not reported by the server.

safe.title: Your work is safe.
safe.body: Versions, ratings and finished matches live in the database, not in this website. Nothing is being lost while the API is down. Submitting will fail until it is back; try again rather than submitting twice.

late.title: What this means for you.
late.bodyCounting: A version you submitted is still admitted and still queued; its trial will run. A match that finished may sit at {counting} for longer than usual. No result is dropped and no rating is wrong — the ladder is just late.
late.body: A version you submitted is still admitted and still queued; its trial will run. No result is dropped and no rating is wrong — the ladder is stopped, not damaged.

inFlight.title: Versions in flight.
inFlight.body: {admitting} being admitted and {trialling} waiting for a trial. That is the ordinary state of a live season, and it is what a competitor whose version has not moved actually wants to know.

meaning.title: What these two mean
meaning.arena: The **arena** is running when matches are being scheduled, played and rated. If it stops, nothing is lost: versions stay active, ratings stay where they are, and the queue drains when it comes back.
meaning.api: The **API** is what this website reads. If it stops answering, the site cannot show a leaderboard even though the arena may be playing perfectly well behind it — which is why the two are reported apart.
